text: FIRST VOICE A morning walk can be a truly pleasant experience because the world feels quieter and fresher in the early hours. The air is cool and clean, birdsong fills the surroundings, and the soft light of dawn creates a gentle, peaceful atmosphere. It offers a rare moment of calm before the day grows busy, allowing the mind to settle, the body to awaken gradually, and the spirit to feel quietly renewed. MORNING END

SECOND VOICE An evening garden offers a gentle retreat from the bustle of the day, when cooler air settles softly among the leaves and the fading light casts everything in warm, golden tones. Sounds become more noticeable — birdsong quieting, crickets beginning their chorus — while fragrant flowers like jasmine and evening primrose release their subtle perfumes. It is a naturally peaceful time, inviting stillness and quiet reflection. GARDEN END
